packs.name: Bioicons
packs.summary: 2,830 science icons covering chemistry, cell biology, lab equipment, sequencing and clinical imagery, contributed by many authors. Strong on epigenetics: histones, nucleosomes, 5mC and 5hmC, chromatin states and Tn5 for ATAC. Most icons ask for attribution and a few are share-alike, both flagged in the sidebar.

packs.name: SciDraw
packs.summary: 612 community-contributed scientific drawings with a DOI and a named author on each. Strongest on whole animals and neuroscience: mice, rats, zebrafish, flies and birds, brains and behavioural setups, plus a large set of cells. Material neither BioArt nor Bioicons covers. Every drawing is CC BY or CC0, and none is share-alike.
